newsSince: -11.1% since prior, +7.3% YTD. Fuji Electric continues to build out DC-relevant power capacity: a new Malaysia factory building with construction starting June 2026 (operation Oct 2026), Tsukuba switchboard/power-supply capacity expansion to ~1.7x (construction Sept 2026), Kobe expansion to ~1.5x (Oct 2026), and SiC lines ramping in FY2026 with module sales targeted to more than double. Most plans were disclosed pre-June 6, but the Malaysia construction start is a fresh execution milestone.
